OWNER_BACKUP_RECOVERED_ON_FRESH_RUNNER or INCONCLUSIVE; no acquisition authority

Recovery/report missing by17:30 -> custody UNVERIFIED, no completed evidence claim; no rerun/reschedule.

networkBudgetBoundary: Exact counts above are application-controlled artifact HTTPS transactions, not total GitHub infrastructure/browser/TLS operations. Dispatch, runner provisioning, checkout and log streaming use GitHub-managed control traffic whose request count cannot be bounded by this application; bounded separately by run/job counts, bytes and time. No all-network-request-count claim.
freshRecovery: GET metadata by exact artifact ID

zeroSpend.requirement: Repository-scoped Actions paid-use hard stop at USD0, covering compute/artifact storage, must be demonstrated effective before any run. If scoped zero-stop unavailable or semantics unknown, execution BLOCKED, no trial run or budget increase.
